notes.title: January Update!!
notes.notes:
Hey Community! Fuse just got updated with some new stuff. The update includes some new features to improve and speed up the Substance and texturing workflow, and some brand new content! Your copy of Fuse should update automatically in your Steam client (like pretty much everything else).

Here's a changelog:
Changed the names of the materials and textures to include the character name and clothing type
Added the ability to copy/paste substances! Crazy fast!
Added the ability to import external Allegorithmic’s Substance technology files (.sbsar)
Added export option for including the occluded character geometry


New Content added:
Open Jacket with Shirt
Casual Blouse
Casual Skirt
Professional Dress Jacket
Professional Dress Skirt
Suit Jacket with Shirt and Tie
Trenchcoat
Tank Top
Sweatshirt (Closed)
Sweatshirt (Open)
Workout Shorts
Black Dress Shoes
Cowboy Boots

On top of that, the Substance Expansion pack (25 extra Allegorithmic Substance .sbsar files) has seen a dramatic price change to $19.99 that was based on your feedback! And now that we're in Steam's new Weeklong Sale, with the discount on top of that, the price is all the way down to $9!! OMGawrsh!

Big plans this spring, really looking forward to GDC!

-T

notes.title: December Update to Fuse!
notes.notes:
Hey Community! We're excited to let you know that the December update to Fuse has been rolled out. The update includes some new features, much improved existing ones, a bug fix or two, and some brand new content! Your copy of Fuse should update automatically in your Steam client (like pretty much everything else).

Here's a changelog:
Added Save/Open functionality for your characters
Added "Triangulate Mesh" Export option
Added Poly Count, Triangle Count (View/Show Poly Count)
Light mode cycling (Key Light, 3-Point Light, MatCap)
Improved camera navigation
Added axis labels (Windows)
Fixed AMD OpenGL issue on Mac
1-Click Substance UI improvements 
- You can now preview multiple substances easily, as the current substance remains active after selecting a new substance.
- substance selection is one click, no more "Change Substance" button
- made substance category tabs less wide, to allow whole window to be narrower
Autosave every 10 minutes to ~/fuse_autosave.fuse
New Content added:
- 2 heads
- 7 glasses
- 3 polygonal strip hair meshes with alpha masking
- 15 texture based hair options in the body texture controls
- 4 hats
- 1 bikini top and bottom

There are many exciting things coming up for Fuse in the new year, stay tuned, and Happy Holidays!
-T
